notes.Ajay Mitchell: Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace were both hurt Sunday, and Mitchell had 18 points, six rebounds, four assists and three steals in 27 minutes off the bench. Oklahoma City has not posted its Monday report yet.
notes.Alex Caruso: He had 12 points, seven rebounds and six assists in 22 minutes Sunday after Jalen Williams and Cason Wallace were both hurt. Oklahoma City has not posted its Monday injury report yet, and this is the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Jared McCain: He started the second half Sunday for Cason Wallace but scored only three points in 21 minutes. Oklahoma City has not posted its Monday report yet, and his role grows if Wallace and Jalen Williams sit.
notes.Jay Huff: Ivica Zubac sprained his ankle Sunday, and Huff started the second half and had 14 points in 21 minutes. Indiana has not posted Zubac's Monday status yet.
notes.Obi Toppin: He had 16 points and six rebounds in 20 minutes Sunday after Ivica Zubac sprained his ankle in the first quarter. Indiana has not posted its Monday report yet, and Toppin is the small-ball backup center if Zubac sits.
notes.Tyrese Haliburton: He had 24 points and 10 assists on 8-of-13 shooting in 31 minutes Sunday, and his minutes have gone 34, 32 and 31. Monday is the second night of a back-to-back in a game with a 240.5-point total, the highest on the slate.
notes.Kyrie Irving: He returns on a minutes limit after playing 24 and 25 minutes in his first two games.
notes.Zaccharie Risacher: Naji Marshall is out with an illness, and Risacher has played 32 minutes in each of the last two games.
notes.Khaman Maluach: Oso Ighodaro is doubtful, so Maluach should start at center again.
notes.Dennis Schroder: Coby White is still out, and Schroder played 38 minutes Saturday.
notes.Grayson Allen: Kon Knueppel and Coby White are out, and Allen played 34 minutes off the bench Saturday.
notes.Kyshawn George: AJ Dybantsa is still out, and George had 22 points and nine rebounds in 36 minutes Saturday.
notes.Zach Edey: He sat Sunday for left ankle injury management on the first night of the back-to-back. Memphis has not posted his Monday status yet.
notes.Giannis Antetokounmpo: He scored 35 and 36 in his first two games, then played only 25 minutes Saturday. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II and Naji Marshall, and Cooper Flagg is questionable with a left shoulder sprain.
notes.Jayson Tatum: He has played 38 and 37 minutes and had 36 points, nine rebounds and seven assists Friday. Chicago is without Nic Claxton, but Boston is a 14.5-point favorite, so a blowout could cut his fourth quarter.
notes.Shai Gilgeous-Alexander: He scored 34 in 36 minutes Sunday, and Jalen Williams was taken off on a stretcher late in that game while Cason Wallace hurt his shoulder. Oklahoma City has not posted its Monday report yet, but the team is thinner around him on the second night of a back-to-back.
notes.Donovan Mitchell: He has played 35 minutes in both games, with 32 points and 10 rebounds in the opener. Minnesota is on the second night of a back-to-back, though Anthony Edwards played only 28 minutes in Sunday's 23-point win.
notes.Royce O'Neale: Charlotte is still without Kon Knueppel, Coby White and Grant Williams, which leaves few wings. His minutes have gone 17, 17 and 11, so he is a cheap punt, not a sure thing.
notes.Kingston Flemings: The rookie backup point guard has played 15, 25 and 15 minutes, with eight assists in the 25-minute game. He is cheap with a steady bench role, but his ceiling depends on minutes.
notes.Jaylon Tyson: He has played 24 and 21 minutes off the bench and scored 15 points Saturday. He handles some backup point guard and crashes the offensive glass in a game with a 233.5-point total.
notes.Sam Merrill: He has played 24 and 21 minutes off the bench as a shooter in Cleveland's rotation. The game has a 233.5-point total, but he has scored only 5 and 7 points so far.
notes.Aday Mara: He has played 12 to 14 minutes in every game as the backup center. Oklahoma City's injuries Sunday were on the wings and at backup big with Jaylin Williams, and the team has not posted its Monday report yet.
Dallas is without Dereck Lively II and Naji Marshall, and Cooper Flagg is questionable, so the rookie forward could see more than his 14, 17 and 12 minutes so far.
notes.Stephen Curry: He rested Saturday, but he is not on Golden State's Monday injury report and is expected back in Denver along with Brandin Podziemski, Draymond Green and Al Horford. He scored 23 and 24 in his first two games.
notes.Nikola Jokic: He had 35 points, 15 rebounds and 10 assists in 44 minutes Saturday. Cameron Johnson is doubtful with a right ankle sprain, which keeps more of the offense on Jokic.
notes.Ty Jerome: He has scored 45, 28 and 31 while playing 32 minutes in every game, and he made all 14 free throws Sunday. Memphis is on the second night of a back-to-back in Utah.
notes.LaMelo Ball: Foul trouble held him to 17 minutes Sunday, but he still had 15 points and eight assists with 4-of-5 threes. Minnesota has not posted its Monday report yet.
notes.Anthony Edwards: He is questionable on the official injury report for Monday, with no reason listed, so check his status before lock.
notes.Keyonte George: He had 24 points, nine rebounds and 10 assists Sunday, his second double-digit assist game in three. Utah has not posted its Monday report yet.
notes.Isaiah Stewart: He started Sunday with Zach Edey out and had 13 points and two blocks in 22 minutes. His role depends on Edey's Monday status, which Memphis has not posted yet.
